delegation.scope: Operator-authorized Cursor control of bound OPPO NEXUS App for real local private physical IMU capture and offline source-exact validation, no autonomous agent execution
allowed_actions: Read physical current OPPO and native app sensor capability
Start and stop scoped local NEXUS App sensor recording as directed by operator
Apply reversible local debug-only source logger only if app lacks export
Privately export immutable Android SensorEvent original data and independently hash
Run local QA tests and record measured device timestamps
prohibited_actions: No Hostinger public deployment or GitHub merge
No Root Android permissions or unrelated third party devices
No fabricated physical sample or whole body reconstruction
No history deletion or node reset

mission.question: Retrieve source-exact, physically measured OPPO accelerometer and gyro SensorEvents from the actual operator-controlled Nexus App and quantify real sampling without mislabeling simulations.
deliverables: Current physical OPPO and app build inventory
Raw private accel gyro Android SensorEvent session at least 60 seconds if physically feasible
Exact SHA256 original bytes, timebase and session provenance
Measured quality and captured gaps with independent receipt
Rollback record and scoped AXIOM handoff
falsifiers: A synthetic JSON fixture passes for a physical Android sample
Device mismatch or wrong boot accepted
Global monotonic check falsely rejects interleaved types
Existing WRITE_INGEST falsely accepted as read-only GET
Original units or sensor types fabricated
Private traces published via public GitHub
acceptance_tests: At least one authentic device-sourced accel and gyro event before physical capture claim
A continuous measured baseline and empirically calculated actual event rates
Immutable private original byte SHA256 and independent receiver receipt
Zero R18 R19 R20 rewrites or public raw traces
pause_conditions: Actual device is not operator owned or authorized
Safe local capture requires unavailable physical human action
A valid private export route is unavailable without dangerous permissions
not_executed: No physical events were observed by AXIOM in the chat
No public deployment or private sensor release
No medical validation or Pixel female start

provenance.copyright_privacy: Private operator-owned IMU raw data must never be published and the anatomical R18 derivative rights remain open.

functionality_performance: At least one real, timed and device-attested private accel gyro event, otherwise source gap
Actual sampling rate measured from timestamps not requested rate
robustness_stability: Only scoped reversible local app operations and separate private raw evidence
No Hostinger and no public raw sensor data
traceability_comprehensibility: Exact R21 predecessor bytes and SHA256 with full commit pinned
Raw original byte hashes and measured device build provenance
